_comment: Printed stops that are really a run of stops (see scripts/lib-stop-expansion.mjs). Applied by parse.mjs after the parsers; the times of the added stops are estimates.

rules.source: SIGA e-mail answer: the printed stop 'Fazenda' of line 501 (Funchal - Boqueirão) is the stretch of seven stops 68337 - 68339 - 68341 - 68342 - 68344 - 68343 - 68345, in this order (towards Boqueirão). Positions and names are those of the SIGA planner stops of these codes (the e-mail calls 68337 'R 13 Setembro 1509'; the planner data name it 'Av. 25 Junho rotunda St Amaro'). The printed time is taken for 68342, the middle of the stretch
